raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Rehab & Strength for Subacromial Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore shoulder function and upper-body strength within pain-free range"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Rehab & Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Scapular control & pain-free loading":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lat and extensor activation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Rotator cuff & posture":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          internal_rotation 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Scapular control & light loading":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Rows and lats":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "R-Cuff endurance":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          internal_rotation 4x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive horizontal press & scapula":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Rows, lats & mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Endurance & cuff":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          internal_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Load tolerance and control":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Pull emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Stability and mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          prone_T 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2 — Strength within Pain-Free Range" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Horizontal strength & scapula":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower-risk vertical pull/row":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Rotator cuff & anterior chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          internal_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x40s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive loading":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x70s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Rows & lats strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Cuff endurance & core":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Horizontal & accessory":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x80s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Pull strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance & mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Load tolerance test":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x90s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Pull power & control":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Maintaining cuff & core":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          external_rotation 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank_up 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 — Performance & Return to Climbing" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Horizontal strength & endurance":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x60s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Pull strength & campus prep":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Climb-specific prep (no overhead)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank_up 3x15 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Max strength & control":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x90s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Pull potency":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Climb conditioning (controlled)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x60s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Power-endurance":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          push_up 4x15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank_up 3x20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Pull & technical strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Return to climbing session (controlled)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 4x4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x60s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Maintenance & progression":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x120s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Pull maintenance":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Climbing readiness":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x90s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
